title: gentianella austriaca f. albiflora
intro: Gentianella austriaca f. albiflora, commonly known as the White Alpine Gentian, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Gentian family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella austriaca f. albiflora include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, such as gentianine, loganin, and gentiopicroside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
